source_hypotheses.required: A fixed standard rational filtered nilmanifold, internal polynomial orbit, unbounded N and a dense progression on which total equidistribution fails.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The one-variable D proof normalizes g(0)=c lambda, applies GT12 Proposition9.2 via Theorem2.9 and Lemma6.7 with the 2014 corrections, and passes to the real horizontal kernel.
source_hypotheses.justification: The inverse-affine transfer at offsets O(N) additionally consumes the weighted coefficient lemma in MF. Unmodified GT12 Lemma8.4 alone is not the uniform supplier.

constructed_objects.required: Produce controlled small, equidistributed and rational factors.
constructed_objects.constructed: The constructed factorization has a small smooth factor, a connected rational subgroup and a rational factor in a discrete commensurable overgroup.
constructed_objects.justification: Use the least standard subgroup dimension and the correct noncommutative factor order; the same factors work on every standard finite cover.

index_domain_coverage.required: Retain the actual progression and interval domains.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Polynomial coordinates use the full one-variable internal integer domain; factorization is restricted to the required interval/progression.
index_domain_coverage.justification: A finite Lipschitz net witnesses the failed equidistribution, and all-cover minimality is tested on the same orbit. No multivariable D5 follows from this node.

transition_maps.required: Transfer small circle coefficients and obtain a right-coset period.
transition_maps.constructed: A fixed denominator clears rational BCH coefficients; the period proof uses gamma(n)^-1 gamma(n+q).
transition_maps.justification: The shift polynomial has zero constant in q, so a standard denominator multiplier gives a lattice period despite unbounded numerators. This is not the opposite left quotient.

consumed_object_identity.required: Recover the original orbit and the specified Freiman function.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Multiplying the actual factors recovers the original g; the F argument recovers the prescribed function on one dense internal subset.
consumed_object_identity.justification: The signed-graph energy argument and local cyclic graph refinement yield one fixed finite bracket-linear expression plus constant and O(N^-i) error.

coefficient_conventions.required: Small coefficients must have the scale N^-j and rational numerators need not be bounded.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Taylor extraction is weighted by degree; rational coefficients lie on one denominator grid.
coefficient_conventions.justification: BCH is handled with fixed rational coefficients. The F proof permits unbounded real beta and chooses short boxes after division.

local_conditions.required: All bounds must be standard for the fixed geometry.
local_conditions.constructed: Finite nets, fixed denominators, proper progressions and finitely many short boxes supply standard losses.
local_conditions.justification: No effective uniformity over arbitrary nilmanifolds or unbounded complexity is claimed.

exceptional_cases.required: Do not assume the final subgroup is proper or the rational factor lies in Gamma.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Only a failed descent step is proper; the terminal subgroup may be the ambient group or trivial.
exceptional_cases.justification: Gamma is replaced by a discrete finite-index overgroup where needed. The F conclusion is on a dense restriction and does not extend an arbitrary quadratic map.

downstream_consumption.required: Section9–11 needs D and the exact one-function F conclusion.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The outputs provide standard-density refinements, bounded geometric data and the reconstructed frequency coordinate.
downstream_consumption.justification: Section9–11 must reapply the hereditary quadruple input after every dense restriction. DF does not itself provide that input.

source_hypotheses.required: Fixed s>=3, m=s-1, 1<=R<=m, a one-bounded f, an actual global unit A of multidegree (1,m), and a dense internal family of strongly represented unit nilcharacters chi_h of degree-rank (m,R), with positive derivative correlation witnessed by a uniformly bounded internal family of lower ordinary-degree tests.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The proof starts with that actual family and reselects models after every rank restart.
source_hypotheses.justification: Hereditary LP03 must hold after each dense restriction. Ordinary weak Definition6.19 objects alone do not supply the required all-limit identities.

constructed_objects.required: Produce core, bracket-linear and independent frequency data and actual real top annihilation.
constructed_objects.constructed: The lexicographically minimal B,L,C construction, nested restrictions and rational covers yield the frequency presentation.
constructed_objects.justification: Failed relations invoke the one-function F statement; D and a nonzero coset integral force the required real character vanishings.

index_domain_coverage.required: The same dense internal subfamily and all required weights must be covered.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: There are finitely many weights and finitely many standard refinements; all retained families use uniform standard geometry.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Finite density losses preserve a positive standard density. Fresh data are required for every restarted family.

transition_maps.required: Universal Hall coordinates must map integrally to the current model.
transition_maps.constructed: The algebraic Hall/quotient node supplies the weighted universal lattice; rational covers and basis changes update the map and character together.
transition_maps.justification: Powering generators and dividing frequencies use a common denominator. The associated character and representation map are not held unchanged under a basis change.

consumed_object_identity.required: The vanishings must apply to the actual character used in LP04.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: The nonzero Haar integral uses the actual shifted quadruple product and its actual lower-degree witness.
consumed_object_identity.justification: Rational periodic factors are killed by a standard multiplier rather than discarded; connected real powers then force real eta(w)=0, not merely an integer value.

coefficient_conventions.required: Keep horizontal Taylor classes, commutator errors and matrix coordinates distinct.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Taylor maps are homomorphisms modulo the stated error groups; successor-rank terms vanish at the indicated top weight.
coefficient_conventions.justification: Core plus four B and any three L directions are independent at each weight on the retained tuples. Scalar frequency information alone is not the full LP04 tensor.

local_conditions.required: Localization must preserve a nonzero correlation.
local_conditions.constructed: Small coordinate circles, interval masks, a finite Lipschitz net and a common rational cover are chosen with errors below the existing bias.
local_conditions.justification: The interval-mask approximation is L1; unit padding is a fixed coordinate isometry, not equality of every varying test function.

exceptional_cases.required: Vanishing arguments must remain valid when some frequency families are empty.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Empty families give trivial conditions; finite refinements and rational-cover constructions still apply.
exceptional_cases.justification: There is no claim that arbitrary weak nilcharacters become strong, or that rank lowering at R>1 is ordinary degree lowering.

downstream_consumption.required: Supply the actual bad-word annihilations to LP04.
downstream_consumption.constructed: This node ends at the analytic frequency and real-vanishing output.
downstream_consumption.justification: The source also describes a later LP04/S12 join. That later invocation is excluded from this node and belongs to RANK/assembly, preventing a circular dependency through LP04.

source_hypotheses.required: Fixed weighted generators, m,R and an upward-closed monomial set.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The local proof uses the free Lie quotient with weight>m or weight=m and length>R removed.
source_hypotheses.justification: Tointon Definition5.4.3, Theorem5.4.5 and the end of Section5.4 supply the Hall normal forms; the local triangular BCH argument proves the particular lattice saturation.

constructed_objects.required: Construct a connected rational quotient with exact lattice intersections.
constructed_objects.constructed: The ideal generated by words with at least two petals or a discarded petal is exponentiated and divided out.
constructed_objects.justification: It is a normal subgroup and need not be central. Integral Hall coordinates give the lattice in this specific monomial quotient.

index_domain_coverage.required: All filtration indices and bad words at every weight must be included.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Higher weights are included in every filtered group; the cutoff is not imposed only at the top.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Upward closure ensures bracket stability and the taut degree-rank filtration.

transition_maps.required: Provide the universal representation maps and petal rescalings.
transition_maps.constructed: The petal subgroup is abelian in the quotient; M_t rescales its graded coordinates and is core-equivariant.
transition_maps.justification: M_t is additive and integer-lattice preserving for integer t. It need not be invertible.

consumed_object_identity.required: A top character descends only if it vanishes on the bad top ideal.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: The local descent lemma is conditional on real eta=0 on the specified top words.
consumed_object_identity.justification: This node does not prove the analytic annihilation. The actual supplied vanishings come later from Section9–11.

coefficient_conventions.required: Integral characters, real spans and lattices must not be interchanged.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Hall integral coordinates establish the lattice condition; real vanishing establishes descent.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The construction does not infer real vanishing merely from integrality or a discrete restriction.

local_conditions.required: The global unit test must exist for an integral top torus character.
local_conditions.constructed: Finitely many local torus sections and a squares partition produce a finite-dimensional smooth unit function.
local_conditions.justification: The sections and partition are fixed for the compact geometry, and bounds depend on that geometry and character.

exceptional_cases.required: Zero or negative petal multipliers and noncentral kernels are allowed.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Additive M_t and normal quotient construction include these cases.
exceptional_cases.justification: No inverse to M_t and no centrality of the bad-word kernel is assumed.

downstream_consumption.required: Section9–11 needs the algebraic model before proving actual vanishings; LP04 needs descent afterwards.
downstream_consumption.constructed: The algebraic model and conditional descent are available without the analytic premise.
downstream_consumption.justification: The actual eta descent and comparison are supplied by the distinct GI-08-LP04 node after Section9–11.

source_hypotheses.required: Actual Section9–11 real bad-word annihilation, a taut degree-rank model, strictly lower degree-rank auxiliary geometry and matching horizontal Taylor classes.
source_hypotheses.constructed: The construction applies the Hall quotient to that character and those represented families.
source_hypotheses.justification: It consumes actual analytic vanishings from GI-07-S9-11; the algebraic conditional lemma is insufficient by itself.

constructed_objects.required: Construct one common lower-rank model for the entire tensor chi tensor conjugate zeta.
constructed_objects.constructed: Successor groups J_i and diagonal lifts D(U_i) form H_i; the top is D(T).
constructed_objects.justification: LP13 rational generated-subgroup and central-quotient geometry applies to the constructed groups and lattice.

index_domain_coverage.required: The equality must hold at all limit points and all required n.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Strong global unit tests, normalized polynomial orbits and the exact triple polynomial are used.
index_domain_coverage.justification: The vertical phases cancel on the full top subgroup, so the whole test descends, not just one component or one scalar projection.

transition_maps.required: Horizontal torus matching must lift to the correct common model.
transition_maps.constructed: Bounded normalization and lattice-class lifts give the diagonal comparison polynomial.
transition_maps.justification: GTZ B9 and B4 apply to the actual filtered source and target. Tautification occurs before the comparison.

consumed_object_identity.required: Downstream rank iteration consumes the full tensor matrix.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Every coordinate of chi tensor conjugate zeta lies on the same lower-rank quotient.
consumed_object_identity.justification: The quotient equality identifies the actual input and output represented sequences; selecting a nonzero component would not suffice.

coefficient_conventions.required: Lower rank and lower ordinary degree differ.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The result has degree-rank at most (m,R-1).
coefficient_conventions.justification: Only R=1 gives ordinary degree at most m-1. Bounds are for fixed m,R, dimensions and character, not unbounded character complexity.

local_conditions.required: All local lifts and test bounds must be standard and uniform over the family.
local_conditions.constructed: Fixed finite charts and bounded normalization provide common geometric and Lipschitz bounds.
local_conditions.justification: Polynomial coefficients and interval length do not enter the chosen finite geometry.

exceptional_cases.required: Components may vanish and old tests need not already be equivariant for the full ordinary top.
exceptional_cases.constructed: The full matrix argument permits zero components.
exceptional_cases.justification: The later S12 ordinary-top extension chooses a new compatible test before this comparison; unit completion alone is not that extension.

downstream_consumption.required: S12 and rank restart need the same tensor and a global padded output.
downstream_consumption.constructed: This node supplies the lower-rank tensor once its actual input test is fixed.
downstream_consumption.justification: S12 supplies the global multidegree output and fixed isometry; RANK removes incoming padding on the first tensor factor only.

source_hypotheses.required: The actual Section9–11 family has form g0 M_{fractional(alpha h)} g1 in the LP04 quotient.
source_hypotheses.constructed: Core data are independent of h, with fixed rational Hall geometry and abelian petal groups.
source_hypotheses.justification: The construction uses the ordered actual family, not merely scalar matching data.

constructed_objects.required: Construct a global unit multidegree (1,m) output equal to a fixed padding of zeta_h.
constructed_objects.constructed: The explicit K law, additive shear rho and right semidirect H law produce the two-variable model.
constructed_objects.justification: The full Lie bidegree filtration includes H_(0,1), H_(1,0) and the central H_(1,m), with an explicit integer lattice.

index_domain_coverage.required: Cover all integer inputs before transferring to limit inputs.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: The actual Z^2 source and target filtrations are checked before GTZ B4 is applied.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Binomial formulas include negative increments, and exact lattice right multiplication reduces alpha h. Fixed charts cover every box and retain a positive-density subfamily.

transition_maps.required: Extend the top character integrally before comparison.
transition_maps.constructed: The Hall basis extends eta from rank top T to ordinary G_m; a new G_m-equivariant unit test is chosen.
transition_maps.justification: Its restriction to T is the original character, so the actual LP04 comparison can be applied to this chosen test. An arbitrary old T-test is not silently upgraded.

consumed_object_identity.required: Recover the same zeta_h with fixed zero padding.
consumed_object_identity.constructed: Finite chart tests and global same-frequency unit completion give Z(h,n)=I zeta_h(n).
consumed_object_identity.justification: The inclusion I is fixed. Combining with the entire LP04 matrix uses a fixed unit contraction with no component division.

coefficient_conventions.required: Respect left/right conventions and avoid treating M_t as an automorphism.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: The additive shear rho is invertible; M_t need not be.
coefficient_conventions.justification: The specified right H law and right lattice reduction give the polynomial identity; reversing them changes the sequence.

local_conditions.required: The number of charts, target class and Lipschitz bounds must be independent of coefficients.
local_conditions.constructed: A fixed finite positive-margin cover and partition give density at least a standard reciprocal chart number.
local_conditions.justification: Target class is at most m+1 and bounds depend on the fixed source geometry, not h or N.

exceptional_cases.required: Empty petal families, trivial top and zero character must be included.
exceptional_cases.constructed: The formulas specialize to trivial rescalings and trivial torus functions in those cases.
exceptional_cases.justification: Global transfer uses standard constructions and exact all-limit identities; zero padding does not create new nonvanishing assumptions.

downstream_consumption.required: Rank iteration needs full lower-rank matrix and the exact global padded output.
downstream_consumption.constructed: This construction supplies the latter and selects the ordinary-top test used by LP04 for the former.
downstream_consumption.justification: It does not assert ordinary degree lowering at R>1. The combined join is consumed anew at each rank restart.
